Case 01.title: Smart Factory Consulting
Case 01.subtitle: Establishing a Smart Factory Roadmap for Company A
Case 01.challenge: Lack of system-based operational experience and need to set direction for data management
solutions: Collected, analyzed, and utilized data through on-site diagnosis to create a smart factory roadmap
results: Set targets for 30% productivity improvement and 44% quality enhancement
Established innovation tasks to define smart factory direction
Created a roadmap and strategy for executing innovation tasks
benefits: Laid the foundation for smart factory transformation

Case 02.title: WMS (Warehouse Management System) Implementation
Case 02.subtitle: Integrated Management of Raw Materials, Finished Goods, and VMI Warehouses
Case 02.challenge: Insufficient real-time inventory tracking and location management, need to strengthen regulatory compliance
solutions: Standardized warehouse operation processes and master data
Developed Value Added Services (assembly, depletion, etc.)
Built a cloud-based globally scalable WMS
results: Enhanced supply chain responsiveness and operational efficiency
Established a digital warehouse management foundation
Strengthened regulatory compliance and response capabilities

Case 03.title: Integrated Disaster Monitoring System
Case 03.subtitle: Advanced Disaster Prevention System for Company A
Case 03.challenge: Lack of integration between related systems caused slower crisis response and increased costs
solutions: Built an integrated disaster monitoring system combining fire, gas, temperature sensors, and CCTV
Established early response and prevention systems through real-time monitoring and statistical analysis
Implemented enterprise-wide crisis management with timely alerts and risk detection
results: Operated a real-time disaster detection and integrated monitoring system
Improved preventive operation efficiency through integrated data monitoring and analysis
benefits: Saved 7.6 billion KRW annually in operational costs

Case 04.title: Smart Factory Equipment Automation
Case 04.subtitle: Bidirectional Real-Time Data Integration System
Case 04.challenge: Real-time processing of large-scale data and flexible response to changing manufacturing environments
solutions: Established a standard data collection framework for the plant floor
Applied modeling-based standard adaptors for each equipment
Enabled bidirectional real-time integration with new manufacturing systems (MES/Quality Control)
results: Tracked quality across all processes on a lot basis
Improved ability to respond to equipment additions, modifications, line changes, and business expansion
benefits: Reduced equipment automation implementation time by 34%

solutions.title: Digital Transformation Solutions
solutions.corecode: An integrated data interface solution that connects and optimizes scattered data within the company in real time. It standardizes the flow of data across complex systems to ensure a seamless work environment, while efficiently managing business data assets with strong security and flexible scalability.
solutions.nexumm: A next-generation warehouse management system (WMS) that enables efficient warehouse operations and precise inventory management. It visualizes the entire logistics process in real time from inbound to outbound, preventing order-picking errors and optimizing workflows, ensuring reduced operating costs and improved service quality for your warehouse.

corecode.title: CoreCode
corecode.description: Introducing CoreCode by RHISTLE: A powerful interface solution bridging the gap between facilities and systems. Experience seamless real-time data acquisition and stable equipment control.

hero.name: Data Interface Solution
hero.tagline: Connecting dispersed data into a single, unified flow
hero.description: An integrated Low-Code data interface solution that collects and connects data from diverse equipment and systems in real time.

overview.p1: In the Industry 4.0 era, data is a core enterprise asset and effective data collection and management are critical success factors. Yet manufacturing environments face significant constraints when it comes to gathering and managing data for continuous innovation.
overview.p2: CoreCode provides a unified environment that makes it easy and fast to develop, modify, and operate Low-Code IoT data integration and storage.

items.title: Standards-Based Architecture
details: Support for standard communication protocols (OPC, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, and more)

items.title: Rich Data Integration Asset Library
details: 100+ Adaptor types (PLC, Sensors, Files, DB, and more)
Proven integration technology and deep domain know-how

keyFeatures.desc: Modeling (Low-Code)-based development delivers high productivity, while the engine handles large-scale data quickly and reliably — giving you the flexibility to adapt as your integration landscape evolves.
